title: Fixed-dimensional separated Euclidean distances below 0.74 n squared
summary: For every natural n at least 68000, the formalization constructs n injectively indexed points in the fixed Euclidean space R^458999. Distances between distinct points are at least one, distances attached to different unordered non-diagonal pairs differ by at least one, and both every pair distance and the diameter are strictly below (37/50)n^2. The dimension and threshold are explicit sufficient bounds; no optimality or independent priority review is claimed. This code-only port preserves the theorem of the cited public formalization.
